human_understanding_delta: The Reeb topology producer is closed and simultaneously shown to be metrically inert. Cutting the value disk along the outward critical slits leaves a star-shaped, hence simply connected, region, so the covering splits into exactly k conformal sheets, one per root; simple critical values transpose two sheets, and k-1 transpositions acting transitively on k labels give a tree whose geometric realisation is the canonical inverse-ray arc system. Cutting along the complete critical rays leaves sectors with no branch value, so each preimage component really is a Euclidean strip in log-polar coordinates. But a Newton trajectory satisfies f(gamma(t))=e^-t f(gamma(0)), so its value argument is frozen; entering a saddle neighbourhood of value radius delta forces rho_c |sin(theta - theta_c)| < delta, an angular window of measure exactly 2 arcsin(delta/rho_c). Hence locally glued Newton skeletons converge to min_c L(c) for a pair and to sum_c L(c) for a spanning graph: the lane's ceiling is exactly the admissible-hub statement, no better and no worse, so the 4/25 Cassini deficit cannot be repaired by finer local Morse bookkeeping. Two things go beyond the desk return. The window exponent is the ramification index, so on the extremal family z^n - r^n, whose hub has multiplicity n-1, the attachable fraction of directions is exactly (eps/r)^n - the strip average degrades fastest precisely where the problem is tight. And the endpoint term of the recorded budget identity is now explicit: the incident tangent at a root a is exp(i(theta_c - arg f'(a))), so the surviving componentwise charge is 2Rm + sum_a Re(a exp(i arg f'(a)) S_a) + sum_e K_e >= 0 with S_a the sum of exp(-i theta_c) over incident critical points, which is the cyclic-order object CriticalTreeLengthCharge.md explicitly asked for.
